title: An earlier row can open its editor after a later tap
reproduction: Hold the subscribed row's disk read; tap a different compatible row; complete in reverse order.
expected: Only the last tap may navigate. Stopping the screen invalidates an outstanding tap.
observed: Two intents [103,-1], including the older stored-source editor.
fix: Use one per-tap owner across stored, remote and review routes; invalidate on stop. Cache remains independent.
test_evidence: API 34 red then green; stopped-screen and fresh editor checks; 17/17 focused. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: Retry with a nameless detail response leaves the editor blank
reproduction: Tap a named summary; after temporary failure and a no-URL detail, retry with a URL and no detail name.
expected: Keep the directory name with the resolved URL; Back does not subscribe.
observed: The real editor label was blank.
fix: Both editor routes fall back to the selected summary name for blank or absent detail names.
test_evidence: API 34 assertion failed before the fix; visible errors, populated editor, URL and unsaved Back passed after. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: Confirmation misstates candidate count as guaranteed additions
reproduction: Check one eligible row and choose Subscribe selected.
expected: Use correct quantity-neutral wording; existing and missing results are not new additions.
observed: The dialog promised to add 1 DNS-safe selected lists.
fix: Describe the number of candidates to process for both scopes.
test_evidence: On signed 8e2eace32 both 1 and 2 confirmed visually; real two-row worker result and removal checked. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: README describes tapping a row as subscribing
reproduction: Compare README row instructions with the installed directory; distinguish the historical simulator notes from shipped semantics.
expected: Describe the row editor, switches and supported subset separately.
observed: The documented gesture did not match the app; archived simulation could be mistaken for current behavior.
fix: Document row and switch separately and label the simulation as historical.
test_evidence: Installed row opened the source editor; Back left switch off. Checked selection, cancellation and worker results separately. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: Two printed C declarations do not compile against archived headers
reproduction: Extract manual SYNOPSIS and compile against the checked-in header.
expected: Printing the declaration alongside the header should compile.
observed: Conflicting qualifiers and a missing semicolon.
fix: Align declarations with pcap/pcap.h and clarify the callback pointer.
test_evidence: 55 manuals lint clean and all synopsis blocks compile; 71 named declarations checked; no capture. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: Multiple manual entries describe the wrong function or return status
reproduction: Trace printed setter, return owner, output fields and pre-activation statuses to this specific vendored version.
expected: Callers can distinguish the named operations and their actual status conventions.
observed: Wrong setter and return owner, unsupported timestamp-return claim and omitted pre-activation failures.
fix: Correct the affected manuals using the archived dispatch table, implementations and header.
test_evidence: Reviewed descriptions and return sections for 54 function manuals; 55 synopsis/lint checks; not a platform execution test. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: Compatibility wrapper reports success for a rejected operation
reproduction: Compile the actual wrapper with an inert callback returning -3, -1, 0 and 4.
expected: Normalize every negative result to -1; nonnegative means success.
observed: -3 incorrectly mapped to 0 in the baseline.
fix: Test the sign of the result rather than equality with -1.
test_evidence: Host compile-and-run: 1/4 mismatched before, 0/4 after. No interface, file capture or networking; module is not in the Android build. See tasks/audit-2026-11-25/deep-signoff/discover-pick-order.md.

title: Development CI accepted stale reviewed fingerprints
reproduction: Compare the inventory with the seven changed application and documentation files at 8e2eace32; inspect the required development build.
expected: A revision with a stale inventory cannot pass the build.
observed: Six changed files retained earlier reviewed fingerprints, seven mismatched in total, and no CI step checked them.
fix: Invoke the read-only inventory check directly after checkout; document how to refresh without claiming review.
test_evidence: Local drift check failed on stale bytes, inventory regression tests cover mutations and deletion; updated workflow lint and refreshed checkout verification. Hosted CI not yet run.
